newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA, HOIU, FOREX UP IN HEAVY TRADE.
newsitem.headline: HANSA, HOIU, FOREX UP IN HEAVY TRADE.

text.p: * Total trade on the Tallinn bourse was 110.7 million
kroons on Wednesday compared to 66 million kroons on Friday.
* Talse index gained 2.08 percent to 273.30.
* EMV , which was traded on the main list for the
first time, was the most traded with 40.4 million kroons to
close 2.75 kroons higher at 70.50 kroons.
* Hoiupank rose 5.25 kroons to 146 kroons in
trade of 17.4 million kroons after it announced Swedbank might
become its strategic investor.
* Hansapank rose four kroons to 146 kroons in
trade of 10.85 million kroons.
* Forekspank rose 3.6 kroons to close at 193.1
kroons in trade of 22.9 million kroons.
(A complete report follows)
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm).
Estonian shares charged at red
rags on Wednesday after the four-day midsummer weekend with the
index rising in near-record trade, dealers said.
Total turnover was 110.7 million kroons, close to the
record of 114.7 million kroons.
Construction company EMV , which made its main list
debut, was the most active stock in trade of 40.4 million
kroons to close 2.75 kroons higher at 70.50 kroons.
Hoiupank rose 5.25 kroons to 146 kroons in trade
of 17.4 million kroons after it announced Swedbank might become
its strategic investor.
"As there is no final decision yet...the excitement with
Hoiupank will continue," one dealer said.
Hansapank rose four kroons to 146 kroons in trade
of 10.85 million kroons as the market responded to the release
of its solid May results, dealers said.
Forekspank rose 3.6 kroons to close at 193.1
kroons in trade of 22.9 million kroons.
On the free market, privatisation voucher turnover was the
highest at 3.8 million kroons.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn newsroom, +372 6209 201,
reuters@reuters.ee
